essence: The rite begins by drawing a four-cornered figure with ghee on a cake.
The practitioner inscribes a release formula and the hrīṃ syllable in the directions.
The remembered release mantra is 'mokṣaṃ kuru yugaṃ svāhā' and is characterized as dhṛti-colored.
The prepared cake should be given to a friend who is confined in prison.
Eating the prepared cake causes the bound person to be quickly released from bondage.
